product_overview: imaginAI is an MVP backend for turning a text idea into a long-form automated video through a single auto pipeline: script, voice, footage, captions, and render. The system is designed for lightweight local job handling with polling-based status updates and downloadable final output.
core_goals: Convert a text prompt into a finished MP4 video automatically
Provide a simple API for job creation, progress tracking, and download
Offer voice catalog and preview support for selecting the TTS voice
Support user feedback submission for product improvement
Maintain a backend-only MVP with no accounts, payments, or timeline editor

features.name: Health Check
features.description: Provides a simple endpoint to verify that the backend service is running and responding normally.
user_flows: GET /health -> Receive 200 response with ok status
GET /health -> Service is unavailable or misconfigured -> Receive non-200 error response

features.name: Voice Listing
features.description: Returns the available text-to-speech providers and voice models for the user to choose from.
user_flows: GET /api/voices -> Receive 200 response with available TTS providers and voice models
GET /api/voices -> Backend error occurs while loading voice catalog -> Receive error response

features.name: Voice Preview
features.description: Streams a short audio sample so the user can preview a selected voice before creating a job.
user_flows: GET /api/voices/preview with valid voice and provider parameters -> Receive 200 audio file stream preview
GET /api/voices/preview with missing or invalid voice/provider parameters -> Receive error response

features.name: Video Generation Job Creation
features.description: Accepts an idea and generation settings, then starts the automated video pipeline in the background as a new job.
user_flows: POST /api/jobs with valid idea, duration, style, voice, and voice_provider -> Receive 200 response with job details and job_id -> Background pipeline begins processing the video generation job
POST /api/jobs with valid payload but rate limit exceeded -> Receive 429 response indicating rate limit exceeded
POST /api/jobs with missing or invalid required fields -> Receive error response indicating request validation failure

features.name: Job Status Polling
features.description: Lets the user check the current state, progress, and step details for an existing video job.
user_flows: GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/status for an existing in-progress job -> Receive 200 response with current status and progress details
GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/status for a nonexistent job_id -> Receive 404 response indicating job not found

features.name: Download Video
features.description: Allows the user to download the completed MP4 output once the job has finished rendering.
user_flows: GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/download for a completed job -> Receive 200 response with MP4 video file download
GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/download for a job that is not finished yet -> Receive 404 response indicating video not ready
GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/download for a nonexistent job_id -> Receive 404 response indicating video not ready

features.name: User Feedback
features.description: Accepts feedback messages and optional contact details from users to improve the product.
user_flows: POST /api/feedback with a valid message and optional contact info -> Receive 200 response confirming feedback submission
POST /api/feedback with missing message field -> Receive 400 response indicating message is required
